source.adql:
SELECT cns5_id, gj_id, component_id, n_components, primary_flag, gj_system_primary, gaia_dr3_id, hip_id, ra, dec, epoch, coordinates_bibcode, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_bibcode, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, pm_bibcode, rv, rv_error, rv_bibcode, g_mag, g_mag_error, bp_mag, bp_mag_error, rp_mag, rp_mag_error, g_mag_resulting, g_mag_resulting_error, g_rp_resulting, g_rp_resulting_error, g_rp_resulting_flag, cns6_system_id, reference_object_cns5_id, multiplicity_bibcode, remarks
FROM cns5update.main
ORDER BY cns5_id
